_doc: Maps each e2e file to the files or file#fn1,fn2 scopes its cases assert on (see proof.js). Not derived from the require graph. login_state.js#save is deliberately NOT listed: it holds fs.chmodSync(tmpFile, 0o600), and mutation M4 (drop that chmod) is an EQUIVALENT MUTANT with @playwright/cli 0.1.22: the script pre-creates the temp file at 0600 and the CLI writes into it in place, so no case can see the line. A change anywhere in save therefore runs the ui lane live. engine.js is not listed either: the setup page never calls its keepsPlainLiteral/buildEnvUsers.
